title: Grateful Dead Live at Polo Field - Golden Gate Park on 1991-11-03
lineage: Panasonic AG-5210 > Soundforge 8 - 44.1KHz/24bit > highpass triangular dither-> 16bit > CD Wave > FLAC16;

ai_review.summary: Crisp FM‑matrix recording of a historically fun show featuring unique CCR covers and an all‑out crowd vibe.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a bright, crisp FM broadcast that avoids the usual FM “muddiness,” making it a solid listening experience.  Fans rave about the historic collaboration – John Fogerty joining the Dead onstage for rare Creedence covers – and rate the performance as one of the best versions available.  Overall the show is praised for its energy and uniqueness, with no major audio flaws reported.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑star marks and praise both the performance (historic Fogerty/Dead set) and the clear FM matrix sound, yielding a strong combined score; confidence is medium because several reviews are off‑topic.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear FM broadcast with minimal radio coloration; no reported drop‑outs or muffling.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is remembered for its unique historical moment – Fogerty joining the Dead for rare Creedence songs – and flows with high energy, making it a fan‑favorite despite no detailed setlist commentary.
